<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Show member health checks in Apps preferences ([#29242](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29242)) by @ehconitin
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Upsert row-level permission rules instead of a predicate tree ([#30252](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30252)) by @charlesBochet
- Import recurring Google Calendar meetings only up to 90 days ahead ([#30335](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30335)) by @neo773
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Add a 2.60 command that drops the workspace workflowVersion object ([#30500](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30500)) by @thomtrp
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Add generic date functions to validation rules ([#30527](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30527)) by @FelixMalfait
- Rename the navigation menu item folderId to parentId ([#30543](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30543)) by @thomtrp
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Remove the dead SEE_VERSION_WORKFLOW_RUN engine command ([#30664](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30664)) by @thomtrp
- Fix main after the 2.61 bump: mark jobConfig as removed and regenerate the front GraphQL file ([#30752](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30752)) by @ehconitin
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Add the APPLICATION billing product key and make the product plan key nullable ([#30773](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30773)) by @martmull
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Remove the metered billing catalog API and the priceUsageBased product metadata ([#30798](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30798)) by @etiennejouan
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Remove the NOT_STARTED workflow run status - wait after 2.61 to merge ([#30841](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30841)) by @martmull
- chore(security): force happy-dom 21.0.4 under @wyw-in-js/transform ([#31046](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/31046)) by @mabdullahabaid
- Make permission tables the only storage for record shares and access groups ([#31091](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/31091)) by @charlesBochet

## ✨ New features

- feat(dashboards): group the widget picker by chart type and view layout ([#30510](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30510)) by @FelixMalfait
- feat(inbox): list the inbox in the Lab ([#30511](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30511)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(billing): list billing arrangements in the admin billing tab ([#30564](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30564)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(cli): round-trip frontend component source dependencies ([#30613](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30613)) by @Weiko
- feat(cli): round-trip logic function sources and local imports ([#30665](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30665)) by @Weiko
- feat(ai): offer attach_conversation_to_records through the tool registry ([#30692](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30692)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- feat(cli): inspect app dev watch scope with --verbose ([#30790](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30790)) by @Weiko

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Enqueue every workflow run immediately and drop the run throttling ([#29560](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29560)) by @martmull
- Replace the view's sorts when sorting from a column header ([#30163](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30163)) by @abhinavapasok
- Keep the amount when merging a record whose currency has no amount ([#30256](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30256)) by @BOHEUS
- Let a tool's front component replace the raw arguments on its approval card ([#30317](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30317)) by @FelixMalfait
- Apply filter, orderBy and first on nested one-to-many connections ([#30347](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30347)) by @FelixMalfait
- Handle several columns of one field in a table view ([#30348](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30348)) by @FelixMalfait
- Sign in to MCP servers through an oauth-discovery connection provider ([#30356](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/3035

The #1 Open-Source CRM

Website · Documentation · Roadmap · Discord · Figma


# Why Twenty Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves. Twenty is the CRM you build, ship, and version like the rest of your stack. Learn more about why we built Twenty
# Installation ### Cloud The fastest way to get started. Sign up at [twenty.com](https://twenty.com) and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date. ### Build an app Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: ```bash npm install -g twenty twenty app init my-app cd my-app yarn install ``` Define objects, fields, and views as code: ```ts import { defineObject, FieldType } from 'twenty-sdk/define'; export default defineObject({ nameSingular: 'deal', namePlural: 'deals', labelSingular: 'Deal', labelPlural: 'Deals', fields: [ { name: 'name', label: 'Name', type: FieldType.TEXT }, { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: FieldType.CURRENCY }, { name: 'closeDate', label: 'Close Date', type: FieldType.DATE_TIME }, ], }); ``` Then ship it to your workspace: ```bash twenty auth login --url https://your-workspace.twenty.com twenty app publish --private ``` See the [app development guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/apps/getting-started) for objects, views, agents, and logic functions. Building with a coding agent? Install the official [Twenty app skills](./packages/twenty-agent-skills), which work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and any other harness supported by the `skills` CLI: ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills --list ``` The `agent-skills` branch is created by the first successful publish from `main`. Until then, use the [local build instructions](./packages/twenty-agent-skills#local-development). [`SKILLS.md`](./SKILLS.md) explains the other skill families in this repository and who they are for. ### Self-hosting Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with [Docker Compose](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/self-host/capabilities/docker-compose), or contribute locally via the [local setup guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/contribute/capabilities/local-setup).

# Everything you need Twenty gives you the building blocks of a modern CRM (objects, views, workflows, and agents) and lets you extend them as code. Here's a tour of what's in the box. Want to go deeper? Read the User Guide for product walkthroughs, or the Documentation for developer reference.
